correctness.rationale: A 16-state rung-mask transfer T(z), with zero dummy boundary rungs and local omitted-vertex condition b_j=0 => a_j+b_(1-j)+c_j<=1, gives F_n(z)=u T(z)^n v for all n. The rational elimination N(t,z)/D(t,z), D=1-(1+z+z^2)t+(z^2+z^3)t^2-(z+z^2)t^3+2z^3t^4+z^3t^5 and N=1+zt+(z+z^2-2z^3)t^2-3z^3t^3-z^3t^4, supplies an infinite exact cardinality enumerator. Unique simple positive dominant pole at z=1, with positive residue and nonzero asymptotic variance, yields the quasi-powers mean mu*n+beta+O(theta^n), variance sigma^2*n+O(1), CLT with mu≈0.514909291, sigma^2≈0.359892855, beta≈0.521089734. Independent graph-based enumeration and independent transfer calculation agree for n=1..7; finite checks corroborate but the matrix identity and analytic pole justify unbounded n. Boundary n=1 gives four sets unlike the published strict-majority convention.
